label: Bible Study
prompt: And many nations shall come, and say, Come, and let us go up to the _____ of the LORD, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for the law shall go forth of Zion, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.
verse: And many nations shall come, and say, Come, and let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for the law shall go forth of Zion, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.
note: Nations streaming to God's mountain to learn his ways — Isaiah 2 has nearly the same words.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: If we believe not, yet he abideth _____: he cannot deny himself.
verse: If we believe not, yet he abideth faithful: he cannot deny himself.
note: Even when we falter, He stays faithful — He can't stop being Himself.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And when Gideon was come, behold, there was a man that told a dream unto his fellow, and said, Behold, I dreamed a dream, and, lo, a cake of barley bread _____ into the host of Midian, and came unto a tent, and smote it that it fell, and overturned it, that the tent lay along.
verse: And when Gideon was come, behold, there was a man that told a dream unto his fellow, and said, Behold, I dreamed a dream, and, lo, a cake of barley bread tumbled into the host of Midian, and came unto a tent, and smote it that it fell, and overturned it, that the tent lay along.
note: A Midianite dreamed a barley loaf tumbled into camp and flattened a tent — Gideon overheard and worshipped.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth were passed away; and there was no more _____.
verse: And I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth were passed away; and there was no more sea.
note: John, exiled on the island of Patmos, sees a new world where the sea is no more.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And the LORD said unto Moses, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a _____ people:
verse: And the LORD said unto Moses, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people:
note: After the golden calf, God's verdict on Israel: 'a stiffnecked people' — like oxen refusing to bow to the yoke.
